description: Lignes électriques de hautes tensions 3D is a dataset listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. 3D high voltage line network data derived from 2019 LiDAR data. The lines were seized based on the points classified as high voltage lines in the point cloud of the 2019 LiDAR flyby. Coverage: Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. The portal shows the English title as "High voltage 3D power lines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Administration du cadastre et de la topographie. Its keywords include modele-3d, 3d-data, 3d-models, 3d-lidar, powergrid. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is notspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
